A 12ft office container is the size most growing startups reach for when a 10ft unit feels cramped but a 20ft is more room than the team needs. It gives you a compact, lockable, ready-to-use workspace that can sit on a project site, a factory yard, or a leased plot — and move with you when the business does. This guide explains what a 12ft office container is good for, how it is built, and what to confirm before you order one.

What a 12ft Office Container Is Best For

A 12ft office container is a single-room steel office roughly 12 ft long and about 7.5 ft wide — enough for one to two workstations, a filing cabinet, and a small printer or document corner. It suits a startup founder who needs a private cabin, a site supervisor's office, a sales or enquiry desk, or a security-cum-admin point at a gate.

The appeal for early-stage teams is simple: you avoid a long commercial lease, you get a defined cost, and the unit is an asset you can relocate. When the team grows, you add a second unit or move up to a 20ft rather than renegotiate a lease.

SAMAN builds these units as a direct manufacturer. You can see sizes, specifications and request a written quote on our container office cabin range.

How a 12ft Office Container Is Built

A SAMAN office container is fabricated on a mild-steel (MS) frame using IS 2062 structural steel, with insulated wall panels, a steel or insulated roof, vinyl or ply flooring, and a powder-coated finish. Standard fit-out includes a door, one or two windows, wiring with light and power points, and provision for a wall-mounted AC.

  • Frame and base: IS 2062 MS steel, welded and treated against corrosion.
  • Walls and roof: insulated panels to keep the interior usable through an Indian summer.
  • Interior: clean panel lining, vinyl or ply floor, electrical points, AC provision.
  • Security: a steel door with a proper lock; window grills on request.

Choosing the Right Size: 10ft, 12ft, 20ft, 40ft

Picking the size is the first decision. Over-order and you pay freight and GST on space you do not use; under-order and the office is tight from day one. The table below is a quick guide by team size.

Unit sizeTypical useComfortable for
10 ftSingle cabin, gate office, security-cum-admin1 person
12 ftStartup founder's cabin, supervisor office1–2 people
20 ftSmall team room or cabin plus reception2–4 people
40 ftMulti-room layout: cabin, open desks, meeting corner6–8 people

Customisation Options

A 12ft unit can be configured to your requirement without changing its footprint. Common choices include the interior layout (open desk versus a small partition), the window count and type, the electrical load, the floor finish, and an exterior colour. Tell us how the unit will be used and we match the fit-out to it.

Delivery, Placement and Mobility

A 12ft office container is light enough to load and offload with a hydra or small crane and travels on a flatbed truck. SAMAN delivers pan-India; default shipping is ₹3,000 and transit is typically 3–5 days depending on distance. The unit needs level ground — RCC blocks at the corners are the minimum — plus truck and offload access at the placement spot. Send a photo of the site approach with your enquiry so dispatch is planned correctly.

What a 12ft Office Container Costs

Price depends on size, insulation grade, interior finish, electrical load and any custom features, so a single number on a web page is misleading. As a direct manufacturer we quote against your actual requirement in writing, inclusive of GST and delivery. Share your spec and site location and we return an itemised price and lead time — no inflated marketplace markup.

Build Quality, Warranty and Service Life

SAMAN POS India Private Limited has served India since 2009 (incorporated in 2019) and manufactures at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 and Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308, under ISO 9001:2015. Every office container carries our standard warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 year figure is the engineered service life under normal maintenance, not a warranty period.

Get a Quote on Your 12ft Office Container

Tell us your team size, preferred size, and site location for a written, itemised quote.

Call +91 88616 22859 or use the Send Enquiry form on this page to get an indicative price and lead time. For larger requirements, see our full range of container offices.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the size of a 12ft office container?

A 12ft office container is roughly 12 ft long and about 7.5 ft wide — enough for one to two workstations with a filing and printer corner. Exact external and internal dimensions are confirmed on the quote.

How much does a 12ft office container cost in India?

Cost depends on insulation, interior finish, electrical load and custom features. As a direct manufacturer, SAMAN gives a written, GST-inclusive quote for your exact requirement rather than a fixed list price.

Can a 12ft office container be customised?

Yes. You can choose the interior layout, window count, electrical load, floor finish and exterior colour. The footprint stays the same while the fit-out is matched to your use.

Is a 12ft office container easy to relocate?

Yes. It is light enough to lift with a hydra or small crane and moves on a flatbed truck, which is why it suits project sites and growing teams that may shift location.

What warranty does a SAMAN office container carry?

5 years on the structural frame and base, 1–2 years on finishing, with a 20–25 year engineered service life under normal maintenance.

About SAMAN — container office manufacturer

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions) is a direct container office manufacturer — ISO 9001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (Cert No. E20250218647) certified; NSIC enlisted (Ref. NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207); DPIIT-recognised startup (Ref. DIPP56005); Udyam registered (UDYAM-KR-03-0172770); GST 29ABBCS7101B1ZR (Bangalore) and 09ABBCS7101B1ZT (Noida). We build on IS 2062 steel and dispatch factory-direct from Bangalore (Gopasandra, 560099) and Greater Noida (Jalpura, 201308) with a ₹3,000 default delivery charge and typical transit of 3–5 days. Call +91 88616 22859 or send an enquiry.

Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
